children: Colombia's imports increased 22.9% year-on-year to $7.97 billion in July 2026 following a 27% rise in June.
Manufacturing imports rose 16.1%, driven by higher purchases of machinery and transport equipment (24%) and chemicals and related products (11%).
Agriculture, food and beverages purchases grew 26.3%, mainly due to higher imports of food products and live animals (27.2%).
Imports of fuels and extractive industry products surged 77.3%, driven by higher purchases of petroleum, petroleum products and related products (79.6%).

title: Colombia Imports Surge in July
